name: internship-tracker
description: Full-stack internship application tracker: Kanban board, calendar, reminders and analytics.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -p internship-tracker-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build
scripts.e2e:down: docker compose -p internship-tracker-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v
scripts.e2e:logs: docker compose -p internship-tracker-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml logs api
